details.overview: Blended D3.js visualization work, streaming AI chat, and Salesforce collaboration to modernize 2Creative's customer analytics suite.

sections.title: Dashboard Analytics & Data Visualization (React.js, D3.js, Java)
items: • Worked extensively on an existing suite of advanced, responsive D3.js charts across multiple customer dashboards.

• Rearchitected the dashboard implementation to align with evolving business requirements — including redesigning the pagination logic — which significantly improved performance and resolved a major bottleneck in the live environment.
• Optimized chart rendering and implemented user-specific customization features, allowing users to save and load personalized chart views, contributing to a 22% increase in user retention.
• Proactively identified and resolved a wide range of UI bugs and performance issues, resulting in a smoother and more reliable user experience.

sections.title: AI-Powered Chatbot Integration (React.js, Java, OpenAI API)
items: • Designed and developed a fully interactive AI chatbot UI using React, integrated with OpenAI’s Davinci model via a Java backend.

• Implemented Server-Sent Events (SSE) in the UI using Microsoft’s fetchEventSource, enabling the chatbot to initiate a request and stream responses in real-time as they become available from the backend — enhancing responsiveness and improving user experience.
• Enabled the bot to interpret live dashboard data and generate contextual summaries, insights, and actionable recommendations.
• Boosted user interaction by 35% and increased customer time-on-site by 28%, significantly enhancing overall product usability.

sections.title: Cross-Platform Debugging & Collaboration
items: • Collaborated with Salesforce teams to troubleshoot UI-related issues caused by backend data inconsistencies.
• Contributed to multiple cross-platform fixes, improving data integrity and ensuring consistent behavior across integrated systems.

details.closing: Outcome-focused collaboration paired streaming AI experiences with reliable dashboards and Salesforce alignment.
